method: Static GitHub repository file checks based on sitemap.xml URLs: fetch file, inspect title, h1 in initial HTML, description, canonical, and copyright markers. No browser control testing, no HTTP status of deployed Cloudflare routes, no linguistic/philological verification. JS-rendered headings can yield false positives.

findings.initial: No static h1; noindex redirect present in sitemap
findings.resolution: Added accessible fallback h1; removed noindex redirect from sitemap; keep historic URL and canonical to concordancia-folios.html

findings.initial: No literal h1 in HTML source
findings.resolution: Not a failure: assets/term-page.js renders h1 for terms and index; no content modification
Description added, no manuscript collation claim
Removed second group of catalog totals from homepage intro; single works total remains
Clarified Rose/Krohn OCR as page locators, manuscript sigla as witnesses, verified readings only from individually checked facsimiles/print editions

academic_priorities.subject: Critical apparatus
academic_priorities.work: Individually verify Rose/Krohn readings against printed images and manuscript H where appropriate; no OCR-only apparatus claims

academic_priorities.subject: Editorial translation accuracy
academic_priorities.work: Compare V514, V554 and V297 by locus, document actual correction evidence

academic_priorities.subject: Corpus coverage reconciliation
academic_priorities.work: Unify registry, original-index, remote-index and PDF metrics with distinct denominators; test external R2 status

academic_priorities.subject: Bibliographic identity
academic_priorities.work: Verify publisher-declared shared ISBN against official assignment and DOI publication metadata; use full titles with source provenance

academic_priorities.subject: Deployment and interactive accessibility
academic_priorities.work: Run browser interaction tests, broken outbound links, keyboard controls, contrast and Cloudflare/GitHub Pages consistency

limitations: This is not Yale certification or university peer review
Site-level static checks do not prove all links or user interactions work
No exhaustive manuscript collation or translation fidelity review completed
GitHub changes are not confirmed deployed to Cloudflare
